title: Pink Alien on Rock
description: A pink alien creature with large black eyes and two antennae sits on a gray rock covered in green moss. Its hands touch the top of the rock while orange rectangles float all around against a solid green background.
prompt: A cute pink alien creature with big shiny black eyes, two antennae with pink balls on the ends, and several tentacles sits on top of a gray rock covered in green moss. The alien's hands rest on the rock. Many bright orange rectangles of different sizes float all around in the air. The background is a solid teal green color.
